messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: GPU queue length for service=redwood-inference serving-group=prod-us-west-2 has exceeded 5k for >3m and is growing. Autoscaler failed to add nodes (scale_attempts=3). Possible provider quota or AMI shortage. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/alerts/1759954321

incident-bot: Sample autoscaler error from logs:
```
2025-11-03T07:18:41Z autoscaler ERROR: failed to provision instances: quotaExceeded -> API error 403
2025-11-03T07:18:43Z autoscaler WARN: attempted scale to 96 but limit=80
2025-11-03T07:18:43Z runtime INFO: request queue depth=5120 avg_wait=2.3s 90p_latency=1200ms
```

emily: on-call (EMILY) here. Paging SRE rotation. Taking first-response. pinging @shailen for runtime triage. :wave:

shailen: awake, taking lead for mitigation. I see provider quota errors. Confirming whether we hit org-level GPU quota or a region outage. @nate can you check infra quotas and booked reserved nodes?

nate: looking. I can see we are at 100% of our committed reserved GPUs for us-west-2, burst limit is set to 20 nodes but autoscaler is blocked by provider quota. Opening ticket with cloud: INC-8769. ETA unknown.

maria: FYI customer-impact: early signs of timeouts in hosted API (429 rate-limit & 503 upstream) for apps pinned to us-west-2. CS already flagged three customers experiencing degraded responses. @customer-success please aggregate affected orgs.

customer-success: collecting impacted customers. So far: Acme Analytics (prod), GreenApps (canary), StudyBot (high-volume). I'll DM legal/support to prep comms if this goes beyond 30m.

sam: quick mitigation options we discussed: 1) divert new traffic to eu-west-1 by updating smart-routing policy 2) enable temporary token-level throttling rules for heavy customers 3) manually attach warm spare nodes from our dedicated pool in us-west-2 (if available)

emily: Priorities: 1) reduce client-visible errors, 2) stop queue growth, 3) restore autoscaler. Start with routing and throttle. Shailen/Nate own provider ticket. Ops-lead, can we attach warm spares?

ops-lead: We have 6 warm spares in the dedicated pool (not currently attached). We can attach 4 without violating isolation commitments. Attaching now. Command: `infra attach-spares --region us-west-2 --count 4 --pool dedicated-prod`

shailen: executing manual attach. Running in background, will post output.

shailen: attached 4 spares, nodes came up and registered with runtime (5m). Runtime reports pool_capacity increased to 84 -> 88. Queue growth paused but still at ~4.9k. We're draining; per-token latency still elevated.

emily: rolling soft-throttle on highest-volume tenants to reduce token churn. Config change: `redwood config set throttle.high_volume_users=0.6 --region us-west-2`

eng-runtime: applied throttling rule. Observed immediate drop in new queue arrivals ~40%. 90p latency down to 700ms. Customers still seeing some 503s for in-flight requests.

nate: cloud ticket updated: provider admitted to a temporary inventory shortage for particular GPU SKU in us-west-2, ETA for replenishment 2-6 hours. They increased our quota request to 120 and queued approval, but it's not instant.

maria: CS update: Acme Analytics reported intermittent 503s but can tolerate slight degradation. They're asking for an incident summary and ETA.

sam: while waiting for provider, we should flip routing for new sessions to eu-west-1 for non-pinned customers. Does runtime have cross-region routing ready?

eng-runtime: yes, we can update smart-routing policy. Will apply a canary shift of 20% new sessions to eu-west-1 immediately; full shift if metrics look good. Applying: `routing set-policy --from us-west-2 --to eu-west-1 --percent 20 --reason "capacity overflow"`

eng-runtime: canary shows reduced queue pressure in us-west-2 within 2 minutes. No major errors in eu-west-1 so far. I'll watch the token/cost profiles.

emily: good. I'll escalate to priority incident and notify leadership. Adding incident channel to calendar for postmortem at 10:30 PT.

customer-success: telling Acme ETA ~2-4h for full resolution, offering a temporary warm-node bucket on dedicated capacity for critical customers (manual). They accepted the temporary warm-node offer for a small subset.

ops-lead: action: request increase of autoscaler max beyond 96 -> I've opened infra change to set max=128 as soon as provider grants quota. Owner: @ops-lead.

shailen: summary so far: cause = provider GPU SKU shortage + autoscaler max limit capped; impact = request queue growth, token-level throttling & 503/429s for some tenants; mitigations = attached warm spares, applied throttling, shifted 20% traffic to eu-west-1, provider ticket opened.

emily: marking incident as "Mitigated" for paging (no immediate customer-impact for non-pinned tenants). We'll keep this channel open for wrap-up and postmortem items. :white_check_mark:

eng-runtime: one post-incident note: our autoscaler should detect provider quota 403s and follow alternative behaviors (fallback to alternate region or use reserved pool) instead of retrying and delaying. Filing PR/issue: github.com/redwood/runtime/issues/4123

sam: proposed action items (capture):
- Short term: increase reserved warm spares in each region to handle +50% burst (owner: ops-lead, due: 2025-11-10)
- Mid term: autoscaler changes to fallback to alternate region when quota errors seen (owner: eng-runtime, due: 2025-12-01)
- Mid term: add quota/stock monitoring and hard alerts when reserved utilization >90% (owner: nate, due: 2025-11-05)
- Postmortem: full write-up, timeline, customer communications (owner: emily, due: 2025-11-06)

maria: I'll coordinate the customer comms draft with CS and legal.

emily: good. anyone object to closing live incident channel and moving to postmortem doc? If no objections, closing in 15m.

shailen: no objections. leaving notes in the incident doc. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident status updated: MITIGATED -> monitoring. Incident ID: INC-20251103-01. Postmortem checklist: https://confluence.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-20251103-01

emily: closing live actions. Thanks everyone for quick response. We'll reconvene for postmortem and track action items.
